item.title: Bring your workout history into Murph
item.summary: Murph can now inspect and import Strong and Hevy workout exports as one historical batch, and can safely adapt other clear workout CSV layouts without rebuilding each set by hand.
item.details: Murph checks the whole file before writing, asks for consequential source, timing, grouping, or unit details instead of guessing, and validates a complete batch before saving it. Strong and Hevy imports keep their richer raw-file, refresh, edit, deletion, and replay protections; other layouts use the same canonical workout records and a bounded confirmation read.
